cwe_descriptions: CWE-116: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output — The product prepares a structured message for communication with another component, but encoding or escaping of the data is either missing or done incorrectly. As a result, the intended structure of the message is not preserved.
CWE-285: Improper Authorization — The product does not perform or incorrectly performs an authorization check when an actor attempts to access a resource or perform an action.
